items.definition:
presented or expressed in a subtle and effective way
Her elegance was understated but undeniable.

not justified or authorized
His criticism was completely unwarranted.

having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage
An astute businessman, he quickly identified the market opportunity.

bold and without shame
He made a brazen attempt to steal the painting in broad daylight.

abundant in supply or quantity
She took copious notes during the lecture.

reluctant to give details, especially about something sensitive
She was coy about her plans for the weekend.

relating to custody or guardianship
The court granted the mother full custodial rights.

in a very poor condition as a result of disuse and neglect
The old factory stood derelict for years before it was demolished.

from outside the Earth or its atmosphere
Scientists are searching for signs of extraterrestrial life.

relating to or conducted between two or more governments
The United Nations is an intergovernmental organization.

relating to or using metaphor; figurative
His description of the economy was purely metaphorical.

relating to monks or monasteries
He lived a simple, monastic life.

involving three or more parties
They signed a multilateral agreement.

establishing a standard or norm
This is a normative statement about how things should be.

relieving pain without curing
The treatment was palliative, not curative.

Full; complete; absolute.
The committee held a plenary session to discuss all proposals.

Barely sufficient or adequate.
They paid scant attention to the warnings.

Relating to or formed from sediment.
Limestone is a common type of sedimentary rock.

relating to the study of humanity
She conducted an anthropological study of the tribe.

conducive to success; favorable
It was an auspicious start to the new year.

extremely or unusually small
She was a diminutive figure, barely reaching his shoulder.

having or indicating a readiness to be overly generous or lenient
Her indulgent parents always bought her whatever she wanted.

lacking the ability or strength to move; chemically inactive
The inert gas does not react with other elements.

Relating to the lower part of the back.
He experienced pain in his lumbar region.

Incongruously varied in appearance or character; disparate.
The circus featured a motley crew of performers.

relating to bones or muscles
He visited an orthopedic surgeon for his knee injury.

second to last
The penultimate chapter of the book was very exciting.

moving backward or reverting to an earlier state
The new policy was seen as a retrograde step.

relating to the tone of something, especially music or language
The painting had a warm tonal quality.

relating to or involving sound waves with frequencies above the upper limit of the human ear's audibility
Bats use ultrasonic waves to navigate in the dark.

difficult to control or predict because of unusual or perverse behavior
The teacher struggled with the wayward student.

diverse in character or content
The class was composed of a heterogeneous group of students from various backgrounds.

(Especially of a process or organization) just coming into existence and beginning to display signs of future potential.
The nascent technology showed great promise for the future.

Suffering from, caused by, or relating to neurosis; excessively anxious or obsessive.
His neurotic tendencies made him worry about everything.

Relating to postmodernism, a late-20th-century style and concept in the arts, architecture, and criticism.
The architect designed a building with a postmodern aesthetic.

Involving or showing care and forethought, especially in financial matters; relating to prudence.
The company adopted a prudential approach to its investments.

Inhibiting or restraining the natural expression or development of something; characterized by repression.
The country was ruled by a repressive regime.

unwilling to make concessions
Her uncompromising stance on human rights earned her respect.

relating to the aorta
The doctor listened to the patient's aortic valve.

having large breasts
The dress accentuated her busty figure.

showing cruel disregard for others
His callous remarks showed a lack of empathy.

deserving praise
His efforts to help the community were truly commendable.

relating to or characterized by cysts
Cystic fibrosis is a genetic disorder affecting the lungs.

relating to or supporting the idea of an elite group
His elitist attitude made him unpopular with his colleagues.

relating to horses
The veterinarian specializes in equine diseases.

of or like brothers
They shared a strong fraternal bond.

unpleasant, horrible, or dreadful
The accident left a ghastly scene.

harrowing
The survivors recounted their harrowing experience at sea.

impenetrable
The fortress walls were thought to be impenetrable.

inconceivable
It's inconceivable that he would betray his friends.

new or recently developed
The art gallery featured a collection of nouveau art.

exploiting chances offered by immediate circumstances
The company was criticized for its opportunistic pricing during the crisis.

looking or sounding bizarre or unfamiliar
Her outfit was so outlandish that everyone stared.

Existing at or from the beginning of time; primeval.
Life emerged from the primordial soup.

Relating to the pubis or the pubic region.
The pubic bone is located at the front of the pelvis.

immoral or wicked
The noise from the construction site was an unholy racket.

having or showing no moral principles; not honest or fair
He was an unscrupulous businessman who would do anything to make a profit.

(of a boat or ship) unmoored and drifting
The small boat was found adrift in the middle of the ocean.

providing necessary support to the primary activities
The hospital provides ancillary services like catering and cleaning.

old-fashioned or outdated
The factory uses antiquated machinery.

relating to a congregation or assembly
The church has a congregational style of governance.

relating to the outer layer of an organ, especially the brain
The study examined the cortical activity during sleep.

believing in or based on the principle that all people are equal
The new policy aims to create a more egalitarian society.

relating to glands that secrete hormones directly into the blood
The endocrine system plays a crucial role in regulating metabolism.
